Name: PFM - Advanced Charcoal Kilns
Author: ClassyElm
Description:
[size=5][b]Crafting an Advanced Charcoal Kiln[/b][/size]
The Advanced Charcoal Kiln will become available to craft when the player reaches level 8 in their Foraging skill. Once you have unlocked the recipe to craft the Advanced Charcoal Kiln, you will need 10 stone, 3 hardwood, and 1 gold bar.

[size=5][b]Using the Kiln[/b][/size]
Just like the regular charcoal kiln, you can add 10 wood to the kiln, and the process will begin. Unlike the default kiln, this one will take 60 minutes (rather than 30 minutes), but will produce 4 coal.

The Advanced Charcoal Kiln will also accept hardwood. While this is more expensive, 2 pieces of hardwood are added will produce 12 pieces of coal.

[size=5][b]Automation[/b][/size]
This mod supports automate through the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038]PFMAutomate[/url] mod.

[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720/]Json Assets[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]﻿ (as well as all of their mod dependencies).
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5][b]Translations[/b][/size]
The mod source code is now available [url=https://github.com/ClassyElm/advanced-charcoal-kilns]here[/url]. Feel free to fork the project and suggest a translation there.

[/list]
